statement_summary: Program documented in policies, standards, and the SSP; CSF 2.0 benchmark
Information Security Officer designated in writing
Annual enterprise risk assessment using SP 800-30
Risk acceptance authority by level; device content risk not accepted above Low
Quarterly reporting to the audit committee
Annual policy and standard review and publication
Sanctions, including for misuse of customer device data
No terms, no data: vendor review and security, data-use, and notice terms
Annual Tier 1 vendor reassessment with SOC 2 or AOC review
Partner claim data used only for the repair
Annual independent assessment
Retention of security documentation and no-notice determinations
AI tools approved before use
Unique named accounts everywhere, including manufacturer portals and counter tablets
Role-based least privilege; passcode field visible only to the assigned technician
MFA for all access including vendor portals; security keys for administrators
Termination: same-day identity provider disable; local accounts within 1 business day
Quarterly access reviews and monthly reconciliation of local accounts
Separate privileged accounts; just-in-time elevation
Technicians access customer devices only per STD-08 under recorded sessions
Password rules; no default credentials; secrets in the secrets service
Vendor remote access through a recorded tool, approved per session
Customer one-time codes for portal, links, and release
Runbooks for device data exposure and point-of-sale compromise
Immediate reporting; managers log every report; no sanctions for good-faith reports
Log incidents with the time the company first had reason to believe a breach occurred
Evidence first: no wiping or returning items until released; chain of custody
Breach determination and decision log; no-notice determinations kept 5 years
Contract clocks start at suspicion (acquirer 24 h, Manufacturer A 24 h, partners 48 h)
regulatory_driver: N81-R03 (PCI DSS v4.0.1 12.10.1); Manufacturer A agreement (contract); Partner agreements (contract)

statement_summary: Notifications per the P08 matrix, confirmed by counsel
Ransom and extortion payments need approvals and an OFAC check
Investigation logs collected and retained (1 year searchable, 3 years archived)
Annual exercise of each runbook
Four classification levels
Encrypt Restricted data at rest and in transit, including the lab and bench caches
Collect less: no account passwords; passcodes only in the restricted field; redact legacy notes
Customer data access standard; no personal devices at the bench
Card data only in P2PE terminals or gateway fields; weekly terminal inspection
Checkout page scripts inventoried, authorized, and monitored
regulatory_driver: N81-R03 (PCI DSS v4.0.1 6.4.3; 11.6.1; SAQ A eligibility)

statement_summary: Retention: recovered data 30 days; records 3 years after last service; purge jobs alert on failure
SP 800-88 Rev. 2 sanitization with verification, validation, and per-device certificates
Encrypted, isolated, write-once backups restore-tested quarterly
Devices in locked storage; tracked shipping
Decline data recovery for HIPAA covered entities
Acknowledgment of this policy and the confidentiality agreement at hire and yearly
Awareness and role-based training, including payment terminals and insider risk
Customer devices used only for the repair; never linked to personal devices
No unapproved software or USB storage
Approved AI tools only; human check of AI outputs
Recording announcement includes AI summaries; outbound calls recorded only with all-party consent
